00003| import { cookies } from 'next/headers';

00006|   try {
00007|     const supabase = createRouteHandlerClient({ cookies });
00008|     
00009|     // Get the current user
00010|     const {
00011|       data: { user },
00012|       error: authError,

00017|         { error: 'Authentication required' },
00018|         { status: 401 }
00019|       );

00029|         { status: 400 }

00045|         },

00049|

00053|       return NextResponse.json(
00054|         { 
00055|           success: true,

00057|           error: purchaseError.message

00059|         { status: 200 }
00060|       );
00061|     }
00062| 
00063|     // Update user profile with current plan
00064|     const { error: updateError } = await supabase
00065|       .from('profiles')
00066|       .update({ 
00067|         subscription_plan: plan,
00068|         subscription_status: 'ACTIVE',
00069|         updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
00070|       })

00075|     }
00076|
